Moreover, the haiku invites readers to consider the relationship between time and action. Rather than treating time as something to be conquered or rushed through, the speaker integrates it into their path, suggesting that progress is not linear but cyclical, and that the pursuit of goals is best achieved through mindfulness and alignment with natural rhythms.
